This is the user's requested automatic post-run review in a separate thread
because the desktop app owns the original thread's writer lock. Do not try to
resume that locked thread. Do not commit/push, create a branch, touch thesis.pdf,
or undo the large preexisting dirty tree. No parallel agents or model fan-out.

Read AGENTS.md, RUNNING.md, LAB_NOTES operations, decision 0016, and the current
amendment in docs/plans/family-suitability.md. The user explicitly selected
read-table-2, authorized lowering the sampled base-success floor (now 30%), and
asked us to continue passing stages without repeated approval until the tested
family verdict. The original 35.94% screen's failure under 40% stays recorded.
All other gates, model/stack/recipe/budgets and final-test exclusions stay fixed.

On 2026-09-18 (local date), the user explicitly reaffirmed: automatically harvest
E0 results and start E1 and subsequent planned runs whenever the preceding gate
passes; wait for review/approval only when new insights arise. Routine completion
or a passing review is not an approval checkpoint. Continue all admitted work,
including arranging the next completion trigger before ending a launch turn.
Pause for a failed gate or a new finding requiring a scientific-plan decision.
Do not treat descriptive greedy E0 success as a new sampled-screen gate.

The main research thread harvested and reviewed E0 on 2026-09-17 UTC. Its offline
audit is runs/table-diagnostic-s4008-ops/review_e0.py; evidence and interpretation
are in runs/table_diagnostic_s4008_findings.md. Check live state and the E0 claim
before doing any work; do not repeat E0 or launch a duplicate E1.

First inspect the deployed state at
/workspace/master-thesis-code/pipeline/runs/table-diagnostic-s4008-ops/state.json,
the indicated run's phase_exit.json and logs, process state, and GPU assignment.
Never start duplicate work. If a phase is still live, arrange a later check and
stop without changing the live source. A missing/error completion requires
investigation; do not overwrite a run or score infrastructure failure as policy
failure. Work on the box uses only physical GPU 1 with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1.
The canonical Python path is /workspace/master-thesis-code/.venv/bin/python.

The repaired runtime passed fresh E1/E2/E3 readiness on source
89c6c77e1e7d643fd44495dda4c3395342785afb8eaaf61977175ae134dc14ec and stack
74570e8f708dece02bd348b714ea0db0bb1b063ab84b5ed44169da3a74697245.
The new diagnostic changes only declared configs and operational helpers; its
admission.json binds those inputs and the unchanged qualified runtime source.
Do not change source without verifying the effect and requalifying as needed.

If table-diagnostic-e0-s4008 completed:
1. Harvest it without checkpoint directories, verify checksums, and review all
   100 development_table episodes. They must have distinct seeds 4008300000
   through 4008300099, complete observations, finite measurements, correct
   reward/termination alignment, no transport errors, and no post-terminal
   actions/generation. Check complete visible table/input fields and terminal
   rewards against the final fields, reusing the previous table audit logic.
   If an audit regex cannot parse legitimate observation text, inspect that
   case before calling it an environment bug. Model mistakes and native action
   error feedback are expected outcomes. Greedy E0 success is descriptive:
   the 30% sampled training-temperature floor is not applied again here.
2. Verify frozen config, source admission, current stack and eval env_stamp,
   base checkpoint=None/step 0, exactly 100 report samples matching the episode
   records, and finite per-split thresholds from load_reference_thresholds.
   Record the evidence in a findings file and reconcile taskwarrior.
3. Only after passing review, write runs/table-diagnostic-e0-s4008/review_gate.json
   locally and on the box with status="pass", source_sha256 equal to the
   qualified digest above, and input_sha256 mapping eval_report.json,
   episodes_development_table.jsonl, config.yaml, env_stamp.json, phase_exit.json
   and eval_exit.json to their actual SHA256 hashes. Both exit records must
   report returncode 0. Keep any failed review instead of fabricating a pass.
4. Run the existing launcher --phase e1 --check-only from pipeline with
   PYTHONPATH=. and CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1. Then start it detached as
   /workspace/master-thesis-code/.venv/bin/python -u
   runs/table-diagnostic-s4008-ops/launch.py --phase e1, logging to that ops
   directory's e1_controller.log. The launcher refuses existing run directories,
   checks qualified source/stack/configs/E0 review and reference, freezes the
   reviewed E0 report inside the E1 run, runs 30 updates,
   records the observer, then evaluates checkpoint-final in a fresh process.
   It updates remote RUNNING before each phase and records exit artifacts.
5. Verify startup once, mirror RUNNING with box UTC, and harvest E0. The existing
   launchd job com.openai.codex.table-diagnostic-review watches the same ops
   state and makes one separate review call per run, so it will detect the E1
   completion too. Do not remove its per-run claims or spawn another reviewer.
   Estimate E1 training from measured step times (initial estimate 4.7 hours)
   and evaluation from the now measured E0 duration. Do not poll frequently.

If table-diagnostic-e1-s4008 completed:
1. Harvest without checkpoints and verify all 30 optimizer updates, finite
   losses/gradients, saved final adapter, observer batches 1, 10, 20, 21-30, complete
   paired 100-episode evaluation at checkpoint step 30, unchanged frozen recipe,
   source/stack/reference fingerprints and truthful trajectory records.
   The existing group audit can check endings and reward arithmetic. Review
   late within-group task/cosine/budget-cost variation, not pooled variance.
2. Apply the unchanged Gate 4 feasibility criteria: success 95% Wilson upper
   bound below 90%, budget-exhaustion 95% Wilson lower bound at least 10%, and
   actual E2 opportunity among correct rollouts with valid shorter controls.
   Voluntary no_tool_call does not count as budget exhaustion. Report paired
   E0/E1 success and both-correct token changes. No success improvement after
   only 30 updates is required. Follow the prescribed blinded trajectory audit
   in docs/plans/gate4-pilot.md, using the actual same-family diagnostic; its
   old menu source digest and shifted-family split allocations do not apply.
3. An inconclusive rate permits only the predeclared paired 100-question
   extension at offset 300100, separate run IDs and the original E0 thresholds.
   Pool 200 after that and stop if still inconclusive. Never sample to pass.
4. A diagnostic pass permits the already-authorized fresh seed 4009 final pilot:
   its own paired E0 first, 500 training questions, 300 updates, checkpoints
   100/200/300 and 100 same-family development questions at offset 300000.
   Declare concrete configs before launch and retain all fixed Gate 4 rules.
   Step 300 remains the endpoint. Reuse runners/guards rather than building a
   new framework, and set up the next completion-triggered review before
   ending that launch turn. The current watcher handles only seed 4008.
5. A failed diagnostic or final pilot produces the tested verdict and waits
   for the user's family/protocol choice. No model/environment/stack changes,
   additional screen extension or reward sweep is authorized by this prompt.

Always preserve failed evidence. Update RUNNING on launch/phase change/harvest
using box UTC; findings own numbers and taskwarrior owns open work. Family task
UUID d32cf13c-20f4-4c9b-86ac-14256dc136ba stays open until the tested verdict;
the native feedback repair task is already completed. Do not infer that merely
launching E1 completes family qualification. Do not send messages to others.
Write a concise final report with real checks and remaining work. The launcher
stores that report under /private/tmp/table-diagnostic-review-claims/<run>/.

I will verify the box state and the already-harvested E0 evidence first, then either review and advance the single admitted phase or leave the live run untouched. I will use the required engineering and writing guidance; no parallel work or source changes.
